title: Restriction assignment weight
statement: For a natural number $n$ and an assignment $\rho$ of a coordinate restriction to each index in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, define its weight as the product over all indices of the weight of the restriction assigned there.
hypotheses_covered: $\rho$ assigns one of the three coordinate restrictions to each index in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
